  • Constructor Details

    • Measure

      public Measure(String name, double alfa, double precision, int maxSamples, boolean verbose, double[] quantiles)
      Creates a new instance of measure class.
      Parameters:
      name - name of the measure.
      alfa - the quantile required for the confidence interval
      precision - indicator of maximum amplitude of confidence interval (precision = maxamplitude / mean)
      maxSamples - maximum number of data to be analyzed
      verbose - True, if each measure should be sent on output
      quantiles - the quantiles to be computed (null, if no quantiles should be computed)

    • testDeadMeasure

      public boolean testDeadMeasure()
      This method will check if a measure is dead i.e. no samples are received for a long period (so the measure will probably be zero). This is needed to abort measures in stations that are not reachable after initial transient
      Returns:
      true iff measure has been marked as dead and was stopped
